summary: All iteration 9 features verified end-to-end on the public URL. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9.py covering (a) account deletion — 401 on wrong password, 429 after 5 failed attempts in 15 min, success wipes projects/line_items/milestones/receipts/shopping_items/contacts/media/quote_requests/stage_payments/snags/snag_links/estimates/payment_transactions, files by owner_id, referrals, user doc + old token 401 + login 401; (b) GET /api/projects returns correct per-project batched summaries (spent.hard/soft/contingency, total_spent, line_item_count, receipt_count, milestones_total/done, current_stage, rent_yield, active) consistent with GET /api/project for the active project; (c) digest share lifecycle (GET/POST idempotent, public /api/d/{token} HTML has #digest-kpis/#digest-milestones/#digest-snags and prev/next anchors, logo 404 when none, DELETE revokes with 'no longer active' page); (d) shopping purchase (POST /api/shopping/{id}/purchase creates receipt with correct title/supplier/category from linked line item or 'Hard Cost' default, idempotent across repeated calls, un-tick deletes receipt + clears actual_cost, amount<=0 → 422); (e) rename — GET /api/ returns 'Builder Assist API', /api/join, public report page and public digest page all show BUILDER ASSIST brand header + 'Powered by Builder Assist' footer, no residual 'my builder' text; (f) /api/health 200. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): register → home shows BUILDER ASSIST brand mark + seeded Nottingham project; /projects renders batched summary cards; /shopping add-from-budget then tap row opens purchase-sheet with purchase-amount-input prefilled to est cost, purchase-log-button logs purchase and row shows 'Paid £99.99 · From budget'; /digest shows digest-share-card and digest-create-link-button → digest-share-url contains /api/d/{token}, digest-revoke-button revokes; Profile shows 'Builder Assist Pro', footer '© 2026 Builder Assist Ltd', delete-account-link opens /delete-account, wrong password shows delete-account-error 'Password confirmation failed', correct password + accepted confirm dialog deletes account, signs out, redirects to /welcome, login API returns 401. Cleaned up: demo digest + project share links revoked; no TEST_ receipts/shopping items left on demo account.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (non-blocking, carried over from iteration 8): server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks. Consider migration to lifespan context manager.

Minor (web warning only, not a bug): React Native Web emits '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' twice on load. Harmless but worth sweeping shadow* props to boxShadow where supported to silence warnings.
